Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. In order for the conditions for this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to be met, you must suspend this Tamer and return 1 of your Digimon with the [Hudie] trait to the hand.
Card Q&A.q: After suspending this Tamer for this card's [End of Your Turn] effect, can I choose to not return 1 of my Digimon with the [Hudie] trait to the hand?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer and returning 1 of your Digimon with the [Hudie] trait to the hand, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [CS] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] All of your [Hudie] trait Digimon get +1000 DP.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
